data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. We are sorry to hear about the critical disruption caused by the SSO token refresh failures in CloudDesk Desktop Sync v4.2. To resolve this, please instruct your users to perform a clean reinstallation of the client: uninstall it, restart their systems, and then install the latest version. If the issue persists, your SSO administrator should investigate your Identity Provider's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret within the CloudDesk Admin Console. [T-2412] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
